name: @joynt/foundry-broker
description: Token broker for the public Foundry GitHub App: exchanges a GitHub Actions OIDC token for an installation token scoped to the calling repository.

scripts.build: esbuild src/lambda.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:@aws-sdk/* --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
